name: T2_carry_preserves_gcd

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: A carry-over (each concept sent to a model of the target set) preserves products always, and every gcd exactly when distinct concepts go to disjoint supports; concepts with one image cannot be told apart (the translation gap).
